subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept this separate `registerControlUiEntryPoint` plus launch-token iframe seam as the public plugin Control UI navigation API, or should the auth hardening be folded into the current `surface: "tab"` descriptor/RFC track?
rationale: The PR changes a public plugin SDK/Gateway protocol surface and browser security boundary, while current main already has a plugin tab descriptor path; automation cannot choose the long-term API or trust model safely.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptors
options.body: Use the current `surface: "tab"` descriptor as the single plugin navigation API and port only the launch/session auth, root validation, and proof-worthy browser isolation pieces there.

options.title: Accept Separate Entry Points
options.body: Keep this new API but require maintainers to own the duplicate contract, versioning/docs, and browser trust model explicitly before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC
options.body: Pause or close this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 settle the plugin UI API shape.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptors
recommendation.body: Use the current `surface: "tab"` descriptor as the single plugin navigation API and port only the launch/session auth, root validation, and proof-worthy browser isolation pieces there.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman merged the host-hook foundation and is the clearest history-backed owner for deciding whether this public SDK/Gateway UI seam should become a second contract.
